method: Full reading of helper R2, composer R3, tests and targeted AST-source diffs of verify_tgl_kernel_formalization and _v392_axiom_coverage. Pinned artifacts reread. No main, provider or Lean rebuild.
findings: R2 change is exactly the audit return-code type check: boolean False cannot impersonate integer exit 0.
Runtime metadata comes from the fresh Audit stdout/stderr and requires exact equality of compiler declaration names and parsed axiom names; emitted metadata belongs to the current module iteration.
Unicode-aware parser replaces only the old incomplete name regex. Existing sorry/trustCompiler checks remain unchanged; exact coverage still demands zero outside-trio axioms and one TOTAL line.
The trace_tracial exclusion matches only an entire bare #print axioms command. Actual proof use, an additional command and a commented field remain rejected as the recorded controls require.

Ledger addition is limited to 50 physically embedded Lean paths in the two task namespaces; the historical v389 count is retained. Scientific sources other than the audit metadata emitter are unchanged.
No unknown qualified prefix is resolved by fallback. Ambiguous aliases return no chosen source. Three named absent obligations remain visible.
Recorded tests: helper R2 15 checks and reconciliation R3 12 checks pass. These test extracted deterministic consumers against explicitly labeled prior real audit data, not a fresh whole rite.
scope_limits: The reconciled candidate still needs its own full build/audit/main. The fixture declaration_sources_status is explicitly labeled in tests and is not injected into the real execution path.
Authenticity of parser input is supplied by pinned compiler receipts; this review does not make arbitrary caller dictionaries proof evidence.
No threshold, coefficient, observed data or gate rule was changed by this patch.
